feature_definitions.components: Unmodified existing SLOW Size/Amihud60 min40 normalization and residual60 skip1 centered-rank EWMA .25 MOM60
feature_definitions.primary: M=rank(MOM60), S=rank(Size), L=rank(Illiquidity), np.linalg.lstsq([1,S,L],M,rcond=None), then centered average-tie residual rank RM; no labels
feature_definitions.rank: 2*(average-tie percentile minus same-date mean percentile), frozen component convention
feature_definitions.robustness: M~1+SLOW_RANK; within fixed Size x Illiq3 and5 cells rank MOM60; diagnostics only
feature_definitions.candidate: SLOW_RANK + abs(SLOW_RANK)*centered_rank(RM), official global ranking/quintile weights
feature_definitions.conditional_bins: ceil(n*average-tie pct) within descriptor/date using all finite components before target join; target missing rows never change bin boundaries
feature_definitions.transition: Previous exchange-date membership, absent=neutral. Current side entry has priority on side flip; exit flags saved separately. Exiting means previously in side, currently neutral; no forward membership.
feature_definitions.regime: Provided ETF TOPIX proxy is PIT-safe from official README. trailing60 vol(min40) split by lag1 expanding median(min252); trend60 sum(min40) sign split at zero. No global/future median.
feature_definitions.support: Descriptive cell support sufficient iff mean count>=10 and >=80% dates have >=10 stocks. Do not delete cells or filter strategy.
feature_definitions.boundary: Average-tie SLOW percentile vs boundaries20/40/60/80%; fixed nested distances <=.025,.05,.10; no band search

model: Same-date unregularized target-free OLS; fixed nonlinearity, no learned return model
selection_rule: Exact conjunctive user Sections16,21 gates in REQUEST.md. Candidate0 if any diagnostic gate fails, otherwise exactly1 fixed candidate. No rescue.

permutation.shuffle: within same-date Size3 x Illiq3 cells over all component rows incl target-missing; shared shuffle for all surfaces
permutation.statistics: Mean daily High-Low tercile spread and mean daily within-group RankIC; surface max of absolute HAC5 spread t across all9/all25 cells separately; observed and placebo matched
permutation.offset_units: observed exchange rows within code (wrapped), diagnostic only; per-code missing/relisting caveat reported

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block on jointly aligned daily conditional statistics; same draws for all5 estimands; no model refit

gate.robustness_rule: All3 definitions positive pooled and EX2016 in all3 primary regions (same hypothesized direction); no alternative adoption
